name: Alicia Hildegarde
original_name: アリシア＝ヒルデガルド
source: Despite coming from a Royal family of magic users she cannot use it herself, people have always looked down on her because of that but she remains optimistic. She later has to go a magic school in hope of finding a suitable servant, or else she loses her status.
